game_title: Key Vault – Supply Cache Camp Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp, a high supply cache: the summit pilot must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the summit beacon.
theme: Frost Peaks – Supply Cache Camp: a high supply cache
core_gameplay_loop: In Supply Cache Camp, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the summit beacon. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the vault_keys value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the summit beacon using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the summit beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Supply Cache Camp'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault_keys changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Supply Cache Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 12.
